verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents several of its own scoping mechanisms. API keys are each scoped to a single agent (Buyer or Seller), and agents can be restricted to specific source IP addresses. Agents also get short-lived pay/kya-pay tokens with a committed spending ceiling and an expiry of 10 seconds to 24 hours, and these tokens disclose only the identity fields a service requires. Together these deliver bounded, least-privilege credentials for agents. missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes on API keys themselves (e.g., read-only or endpoint-limited), per-token revocation (explicitly not documented), independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping behavior.
